how: Calls recruit helpers to begin and build a recognisable portrait.
Praise and encouragement accompany people working on the portrait.
A member answers the recruitment call by joining after recognising the portrait.
A bare thanks accepts the supplied template without requesting anything further.
Proposing the picture and specifying a starting coordinate instantiate the starter role independently of visible uptake.
The completion thread credits a starter whose pleased acknowledgement answers the thanks.
An unanswered proposal would add other rock stars to the shared portrait.
Participants dispute the portrait's fidelity through eye-colour and pupil-size corrections.
Participants report a visible portrait and how it has turned out while work continues.
Template and coordinate requests receive specific answers and an overlay guide is offered.
People accepting defence recruitment retrieve a usable pixel guideline and repeat the request when it remains unsatisfied.
A defence warning elicits a commitment to protect the memorial coupled with a request for its template.
Posting a Discord invitation instantiates the candidate's link-only range without establishing who used the chat or what it decided.
Acceptance can explain recognition of an existing picture rather than arrive as a bare unexplained commitment.
Pressure on the portrait elicits persistence and a later destruction warning recruits defenders.
Members monitor changing features and distinguish bearable alteration from damage.
Upkeep includes judging which deviations can be borne rather than requiring every perceived alteration to be undone.
A participant attributes pressure on the chin to a rainbow without identifying individual placers or their motives.
One member recounts helping another musical logo before taking up defence of this portrait.
Members ask about pictured eye colour and explain the distinction between colour and pupil size.
Participants mark achievement during the build by praising the portrait and how it turned out.
Completion posts celebrate collective success and replies credit the starter and express pride.
A post-close recollection records threatened features and the portrait surviving to the end.
